Create a new React page using Veracity VUI.

Steps:
1. Inspect the repository for similar pages
2. Use Tabs for main navigation
3. Each tab must use shadowed Card sections
4. Prefer VUI components from https://ui.veracity.com/llms.txt
5. Use Box/Grid for layout
6. Avoid custom CSS
7. Apply accessibility best practices

Output:
- Page component
- Extracted section components
- TypeScript types
